purpose: Representative publisher-page browser fallback check for direct-route failures observed during the random-base expansion.
method: Opened the article landing page in the Codex in-app browser.
Located visible publisher PDF/download controls from the rendered page.
Clicked the visible PDF controls where supported by the browser tool.
Attempted a follow-up browser-like fetch of the browser-discovered PDF URL with article-page referrer to test whether the exposed URL could be acquired outside the no-download browser environment.
tool_limit: The Codex in-app browser reports that file downloads are not supported, so a successful click could not be saved directly from that browser. These checks therefore do not prove that the publisher blocks a normal human browser download.

checks.title: Responding to Online Toxicity: Which Strategies Make Others Feel Freer to Contribute, Believe That Toxicity Will Decrease, and Believe That Justice Has Been Restored?
checks.browser_page_result: Article page rendered and exposed a visible PDF control; the browser-discovered PDF URL differed from the stale inventory PDF URL.
checks.browser_click_result: Clicked the visible PDF control; direct file saving is unsupported by the in-app browser.
checks.browser_like_fetch_result: 403 when fetched outside the browser page with browser user-agent and landing-page referrer.
checks.interpretation: Treat as direct-route-limited with browser recovery pending, not as final source acquisition-limited.
